Shinkafi made this known on Thursday during the unveiling of the campaign council in Gusau, the state capital.
He said the council was established to mobilise support across the state and promote his vision of restoring peace, prosperity, dignity and good governance in Zamfara.
The campaign council will be headed by Hon. Shehu Muhammad Gusau as Director-General, while Hon. Ahmad Sharu Anka will serve as Secretary-General.
The structure comprises an Advisory Committee, 32 directorates and representatives across the senatorial zones, local government areas and wards.
Shinkafi said the council brought together people from different backgrounds, including traditional rulers, religious leaders, Islamic scholars, politicians, professionals, technocrats, students, women and youths.
Speaking on his priorities, the ADC candidate described insecurity as the most pressing challenge facing Zamfara, stressing that the protection of lives and property would be the foremost responsibility of his administration if elected.
He said his government would pursue measurable improvements in the lives of residents, particularly communities affected by insecurity and displacement.
According to him, the proposed administration would prioritise reopening closed markets, restoring farming activities, resettling displaced persons, rebuilding homes and reviving economic activities across the state.
He said the objectives would be pursued through an integrated security framework designed to restore lasting peace and stability.
Shinkafi disclosed that the unveiling would be followed by the formal inauguration of the campaign council, during which members would receive appointment letters and specific responsibilities.
He added that the campaign would subsequently commence statewide mobilisation across Zamfara’s 14 local government areas to engage residents, understand their concerns and build support for the ADC.
The candidate congratulated the council members on their appointments, urging them to demonstrate dedication, patriotism, discipline and commitment to public service.
He expressed confidence that the council would help the party secure victory in the 2027 elections and lay the foundation for effective governance.
Shinkafi reiterated his commitment to restoring Zamfara’s dignity and making the state peaceful and prosperous again.
